summary: Elevate your talent attraction strategy with our Employer Branding training course. Learn to create a compelling brand that attracts top candidates.
lede: Employer branding training helps talent acquisition and HR professionals shape how an organization is perceived as a place to work. Participants learn to audit internal and external perceptions, develop an employee value proposition for different job groups, and map candidate journeys to identify friction and plan recruitment marketing and employee advocacy.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the strategic and operational aspects of talent attraction and organizational reputation.
modules: Auditing Brand Perception and Talent Analytics
Digital Recruitment Marketing and Content Strategy
Employee Advocacy and Internal Brand Activation
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in Human Resources, Recruitment, or Marketing. A basic understanding of recruitment metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, cost-per-hire) is required. No prior experience with branding frameworks or design tools is necessary, but participants should bring a laptop for hands-on exercises.
